Resolves #6619

Normalizes rebased Webpack context request specifiers in `workerContextRebasePlugin.mjs` and `mainAddonContextPlugin.mjs` to POSIX forward slashes (`path.posix`), wires both `webpack.config.appworker.mjs` configs through `workerContextRebasePlugin(insideNeo)`, and excludes `System Volume Information` and `$RECYCLE.BIN` from worker lazy-import contexts. In `enhanced-resolve` (`lib/util/path.js`), `getType()` classifies `.` / `..` as relative (`module: false`) only when followed by `/`; `path.win32.join` produced `..\\..\\..\\..`, which `enhanced-resolve` misclassified as a `node_modules` package lookup (`module: true`) that climbed 3 levels above `<cwd>` (`../../../`) onto `D:\` (`https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/6619#issuecomment-6657847873`).

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `check-engine-brain-boundary`, `check-package-contents`, `test-unit` ran (`restoration` → `fix`).

Evidence: L2 (unit specs verifying `workerContextRebasePlugin`, `mainAddonContextPlugin`, `enhanced-resolve` `Resolver.parse` `module: false` classification, and `webpackExclude` matching on Windows volume paths) → L2 required (no structured ACs on #6619).

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #6619

## Deltas from ticket
- Replaced the duplicate pre-`#17882` inline `ContextReplacementPlugin` in `buildScripts/webpack/development/webpack.config.appworker.mjs` and `buildScripts/webpack/production/webpack.config.appworker.mjs` with `workerContextRebasePlugin(insideNeo)`.
- Normalized `PACKAGE_REQUEST` and `WORKSPACE_REQUEST` in `buildScripts/webpack/mainAddonContextPlugin.mjs` to POSIX relative specifiers (`../src/main/addon`, `../../../src/main/addon`).
- Added `System Volume Information|\$RECYCLE\.BIN` to `webpackExclude` across `src/worker/App.mjs`, `src/worker/Canvas.mjs`, `src/worker/Data.mjs`, and `src/worker/Task.mjs` so workspaces placed directly on a Windows drive root (`D:\`) skip `fs.stat` on protected system folders.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.
